text:
[issue by Poopooracoocoo]
### Bug Description

Hangs on Mojang splash screen

### Reproduction Steps

1. Launch game with ModernFix and [Entity View Distance](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-view-distance) and with ModernFix's dynamic_entity_renderers set to true

[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
The issue seems exclusive to 1.21.4 (I checked on 1.21.1 and it doesn't seem to crash), so I'm unlikely to fix it until I port to a newer version. I'd suggest not using `dynamic_entity_renderers` for the time being.

[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
`dynamic_entity_renderers` has been completely removed in the latest release.
